description: This file contains unit tests for the LocationTagValidator class in the org.openmrs.validator package. It tests validation logic for LocationTag objects, ensuring proper handling of field length constraints.

classes.name: LocationTagValidatorTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the validation logic of LocationTag objects, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that a LocationTag with valid field lengths passes validation without errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that a LocationTag with excessively long fields fails validation for each of the length constraints.
